sheets.prompt: Interior concept art for a science fiction exploration game: a great hall of bone-white stone split by a deep chasm, a bronze bell hanging over the near edge. While a clear note rings, drawn as pale concentric rings of sound, the stones of the bridge have come down out of the air and lie across the chasm in a row; above, empty sockets where they hung. A stone ball rolls along a groove over the bridge stones toward a plate before the far door, and a cloaked adult human traveller of ordinary height with a round jade fluid backpack runs behind it, a little bell-shaped whistle of blue-glazed clay in hand, dwarfed by the hall. Cloud sea glimpsed through tall windows, small bells carved in niches, friezes of three dots over an upward arc. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, bone white stone, warm bronze, blue glaze, white cloud, pale gold sky light, rose and lavender shadows, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels.
